A clean flat textbook illustration of a mountaintop. In the centre, a glowing figure of Jesus in dazzling white robes. To His left is Moses, holding the two stone tablets of the Law. To His right is Elijah in a prophet's mantle. In the foreground, three disciples (Peter, James, and John) are on the ground, shielding their eyes from the bright light. A radiant cloud hovers directly above them. White background.
